resources.source: 1003 姬子 天赋 乘胜追击 (100304): 「当有敌方目标的弱点被击破时，姬子获得充能，上限3点。」 param Lv10 = [1.4, 3] → #2 = 3 is the cap; the document's own parameter list states it, so the number is not read off the prose alone.
resources.note: The declaration is what makes the rest of the kit mean anything: ResourceManager answers 0 for an id nobody registered, so without it GAIN_RESOURCE would credit nothing and 「self_resource:充能 >= 3」 would read 0 -- both wrong, both silent. ⚠ `initial` is deliberately 0 rather than 1: 「战斗开始时获得1点充能」 is the BATTLE_START rule below, so the sentence stays where it can be read against the text.

rules.source: 1003 姬子 天赋 乘胜追击 (100304) 第3句: 「战斗开始时获得1点充能。」
rules.note: No `when`: BATTLE_START is fired once to every character's table with no actor and no target (TriggerTable refuses a carried-party condition on it), and this sentence has no condition. No `target` either -- GAIN_RESOURCE defaults to the rule's owner, which is the only unit the sentence names. ⚠ The op is fired through ResourceManager.gain, whose default overflow is 0, so 「上限3点」 is enforced by the declaration above rather than by the rule.

rules.source: 1003 姬子 天赋 乘胜追击 (100304) 第1句: 「当有敌方目标的弱点被击破时，姬子获得充能，上限3点。」
rules.note: No condition: BREAK is fired with the broken enemy as the event's subject and is only ever emitted for an enemy (Battle.reduceStance → enemy.breakEnemy), so 「敌方目标的弱点被击破」 is what the event already is. ⚠ Deliberately NOT gated on `actor == self`: the text pays for a break by anyone (which is also why the rule lives on her own table and nobody else's). Set 111's 「装备者击破敌方目标弱点后」 is the same event read the other way, with `actor == self` -- both spellings are pinned by their own tests. ⚠ This is the only rule of hers that can push 充能 to 3 without her acting: an ally's break charges her follow-up.

rules.source: 1003 姬子 天赋 乘胜追击 (100304) 第2句: 「当我方目标施放攻击后，若姬子的充能达到上限则立即发动1次追加攻击，对敌方全体目标造成等同于姬子140%攻击力的火属性伤害，并消耗全部充能。」
rules.note: Three things are stated here and one is not, on purpose. ① The trigger 「当我方目标施放攻击后」 is ALLY_ATTACK (fired by SkillExecutor for every one of our attacks, its own included); ② the gate 「充能达到上限」 is `self_resource:充能 >= 3` -- the cap, read from the declaration above rather than repeated as a literal nobody could check, and `>=` rather than `==` because 「达到上限」 is a threshold, not an equality; ③ the swing's numbers are NOT written here: `skill: "TALENT"` + `damage_param: 0` + `damage_level: 10` reads 1.4 out of skill 100304's own parameter row (index 0 = the multiplier; the row is [0.7, 3] at Lv1 and [1.4, 3] at Lv10 -- use `damage_param: 1` and the rule would read the *cap*, 3, which happens to equal 3.0, i.e. a wrong number that looks right), and the Fire element and the all-enemy shape come from the same skill data. ⚠ `damage_level: 10` is required rather than decorative: a character's skills are all at level 1 in this engine, so the skill's own level would read the Lv1 row (0.7) while the text quotes the Lv10 row (1.4) -- half the damage, with nothing to report. ⚠ `target: "all_enemies"` is the enemy-side group selector (added for this sentence): every other group selector reads `battle.allies`, so 「敌方全体」 had no spelling and DAMAGE reached one unit at a time. ⚠ The follow-up is settled by `Battle.applyAdditionalDamage`, which is the engine's one notion of a follow-up attack and emits FOLLOW_UP; it does not count as an attack, so this rule cannot re-trigger itself. ⚠ 「消耗全部充能」 is `amount: 3` and that is not an approximation of "all": the rule only runs at the cap, and the cap IS 3. ⚠ NOT authored, with the capability each clause needs: ① 终结技「每消灭1个敌方目标额外恢复姬子5点能量」 -- the engine already credits 5 energy to the killer on any kill (StandardEnergyProvider's kill row), and the DSL cannot say 「a kill caused by THIS ultimate」, so `actor == self` on KILL would also pay for a kill by her basic attack; whether the text's 5 is that same 5 is a data question (registered with M-45, together with the missing 「which ability caused it」 axis). ② 星魂 4 「施放战技对敌方目标造成弱点击破时，姬子额外获得1点充能」 -- BREAK carries the breaker as `actor` but not WHICH ability broke it, so `actor == self` would also pay for a break by her basic attack or by this follow-up; the DSL has no 「came from a Skill」 condition (M-45). ③ 星魂 3/5 are the skill-level gap (M-32).
